prompt: ONE original tall1290:2796 production wallpaper for Glaze EGLO NIGHTSHIFT. Traditional reverse-painted and silver-leaf-gilded GLASS artwork, flat artisan verre-eglomise language: irregular thin mirror-SILVER LEAF seams, fine hand-scratched black contours and cross-scraped highlights, deep bottle-green reverse-painted fields, tiny age pinholes and soft tarnish at edges, no digital chrome or3D crystal objects. A coherent tangible nocturnal repair guild occupies lower45%: one broad masked porter with an arch-shaped coat carries a folded little bridge, a very tall stilt-legged worker holds a shallow cloud-shearing frame, a crouching worker repairs a crescent in a large clamp, and a squat lamp-helmet diver rests by a shallow channel of water. They work in a quiet arched workshop courtyard, humanlike invented costumes and understandable tasks, friendly mysterious rather than frightening. Upper55% largely calm bottle-green black glass #102628, slight reverse-paint brush texture and silver pinholes, excellent quiet icon space. Silver #D8DDD4, nearblack #101819, muted amber #B88952 tiny accents. Everyone and every object drawn as flat silver-leaf silhouette with scratched engraving lines and painted green inner fields, not photographic sculpture or CGI. No text, lettering, signature, numerals, edition marks, clocks/dials, dates, battery/weather values, UI, logos, frame, border, phone mockup or collage. One continuous illustrated world.
